title: An inventory part's cost can't be re-entered, a special order's can
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test at your location, in category A, cost $10.00, with no fixed sell price.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with that inventory part and a special-order part not yet received on line 1, both in category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click the inventory part's description to open Edit Part Request.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Click the special-order part's description to open Edit Part Request.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • Cost is grayed and can't be typed in.
  • Under Cost it reads "The cost of an inventory part can't be re-entered."

Step 3:

  • Edit Part Request closes.

Step 4:

  • Cost can be typed in.
